data.name: Manage blog posts through the content manager
data.summary: A site editor creates or edits Markdown blog posts with publication metadata, author details, tags, and optional series information through Decap CMS.

data.name: Open a blog article by its URL
data.summary: A visitor opens a published article with adjacent-post data while unknown article slugs return a not-found response.

data.name: Subscribe to the blog RSS feed
data.summary: A feed reader receives published article links, summaries, dates, authors, and tags from the static RSS endpoint.

data.name: Read topic documentation with related pages
data.summary: A visitor opens documentation topics with breadcrumbs, content, related links, and a not-found response when the topic is missing.

data.name: Retry pages after rendering or content errors
data.summary: A visitor can retry a failed site or documentation page through its error recovery action.

data.name: Share and discover pages with canonical and social metadata
data.summary: Search and social clients receive site identity, canonical URLs, article metadata, and preview image references.

data.name: Reach the homepage from the legacy guide URL
data.summary: A visitor to the moved guide route receives an immediate homepage redirect and an accessible fallback link.

data.name: Discover mods with installation commands and previews
data.summary: A visitor browses available mods with capability descriptions, screenshots, source links, installation commands, and data-read disclosures.

data.name: Recover from a missing site route
data.summary: A visitor sees a not-found page with links to popular skills, the homepage, registry, and documentation.

data.name: Retrieve the site's social preview image
data.summary: A social client receives a generated PNG identifying the site and its resumable-workflow message.

data.name: Read website analytics and storage disclosures
data.summary: A visitor can read the site's analytics, Do Not Track, retention, and local preference storage disclosures.

data.name: Open a published skill by its URL
data.summary: A visitor opens a published skill detail page while unknown slugs receive a not-found response.

data.name: Discover published routes through the sitemap and robots endpoint
data.summary: A search client receives allowed crawling rules and a deduplicated sitemap covering documentation, registry entries, articles, and public pages.

data.name: Copy displayed commands and code snippets
data.summary: A visitor copies displayed text through the clipboard API or fallback and receives success or failure feedback.

data.name: Inspect statecharts as rendered diagrams or source
data.summary: A visitor switches between diagram and Mermaid source, copies the chart, adjusts diagram zoom, and can view source when rendering fails.

data.name: Navigate the site on desktop or mobile
data.summary: A visitor uses primary, mobile drawer, or footer navigation to reach site sections with current-route indication.

data.name: Switch between light and dark site themes
data.summary: A visitor toggles the site theme and has that preference retained by the theme provider.

data.name: Collect site page views with Do Not Track support
data.summary: A site operator loads one deferred page-view tracker restricted to the configured domains with Do Not Track enabled.

data.name: Browse published blog articles
data.summary: A visitor browses article cards showing publication, author, reading-time, topic, and series metadata.

data.name: Filter a sufficiently large blog by topic
data.summary: A visitor filters article cards by a selected tag or clears the filter when the blog has at least eight posts and available tags.

data.name: Follow the parts of a blog series
data.summary: A visitor starts a series from its first part and follows previous or next part links while seeing the current part number.

data.name: Navigate to adjacent blog articles
data.summary: A reader opens the previous or next available article from an article's footer.

data.name: Discover documentation from its overview
data.summary: A visitor browses topic summaries and opens the relevant documentation page from the overview.

data.name: Navigate documentation topics on desktop and mobile
data.summary: A visitor uses grouped sidebar links or a horizontal mobile navigation bar with the current topic identified.

data.name: Jump between article or documentation sections
data.summary: A reader follows a table-of-contents link to a section, updates the URL fragment, and sees the active section change while scrolling.

data.name: Sort the homepage workflow catalog by name, states, or checks
data.summary: A visitor sorts the published workflow table in either direction and opens a workflow detail page.

data.name: Inspect aggregate registry instruction measurements
data.summary: A visitor sees published skill and state counts plus the measured median share of instructions delivered per step when measurements exist.

data.name: Simulate a failed check and a passing transition
data.summary: A visitor exercises the homepage demo to preserve or advance its simulated state, inspect generated events, and reset the demo.

data.name: Explore an example workflow run while scrolling
data.summary: A visitor sees the active example state, checks, signals, and illustrative event history advance with page scroll.

data.name: Visualize a skill splitting into scoped state instructions
data.summary: A visitor sees a scroll-driven comparison of whole-skill instructions and separate workflow states with a finished fallback for reduced motion.

data.name: Choose a skill installation, authoring, or host setup path
data.summary: A visitor finds the appropriate startup command and guide for using a published skill, creating a skill, or connecting a runtime host.

data.name: Explore hierarchical and linear workflow simulations
data.summary: A visitor switches simulation modes, selects or steps through states, plays or pauses progression, resets, and inspects illustrative state details and events.

data.name: Simulate a regression bubbling to an ancestor
data.summary: A visitor triggers an illustrative failure in PERF_AUDIT and sees ancestor handling, exit-hook events, and rollback to GREEN_CODE.

data.name: Simulate a global abort from a composite state
data.summary: A visitor triggers an illustrative ancestor abort from a REFACTOR substate and sees exit events and reset to RED_SPEC.

data.name: Browse published skills and copy installation commands
data.summary: A visitor browses skill cards with descriptions, categories, versions, strict-execution markers, state counts, and per-skill installation commands.

data.name: Search skills by name, slug, description, or tag
data.summary: A visitor narrows the skill catalog with case-insensitive text search, clears the query, and sees matching-result counts.

data.name: Filter the skill catalog by category
data.summary: A visitor selects a category, combines it with text search, and resets all filters when no results remain.

data.name: Copy a scaffold command for an unmatched skill search
data.summary: A visitor with no matching search results receives a sanitized skill-init command that can be copied for authoring a new workflow.

data.name: Inspect a published skill's execution contract
data.summary: A visitor inspects a skill's states, initial and terminal markers, tools, transitions, guards, judgments, context keys, and projected deliverables.

data.name: Retrieve installation and runtime setup instructions for a skill
data.summary: A visitor gets per-skill installation, invocation, state, inspection, and event commands plus an MCP server configuration example.

data.name: Monitor a local run from a skill detail page
data.summary: A visitor connects to a local telemetry bridge to inspect its job, active state, context snapshot, deduplicated events, and highlighted statechart with connection error guidance.

data.name: Inspect a historical event position and return to live tracking
data.summary: A visitor scrubs a run's received events to inspect the displayed state at that position and resumes the live event view.

data.name: Send a named signal to a connected local telemetry bridge
data.summary: A visitor submits a nonempty signal name through the bridge's signal endpoint and receives dispatch failure feedback.

data.name: Connect to and browse a local telemetry broker
data.summary: A visitor loads or refreshes a broker's skill and job catalog with connection, empty-catalog, and local-network error feedback.

data.name: Monitor isolated cards for multiple skill runs
data.summary: A visitor adds or removes distinct jobs and monitors their state and deduplicated event streams through one multiplexed connection with per-target errors.
